Terms of Use

Effective 24 October 2026

These terms apply to the Thai Sprout app and website (“the Service”), developed and operated by the studio OceanAds (“we”, “us”). By signing in you agree to them and to our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please do not use the Service.

1. The Service

Thai Sprout is a free introduction to the 44 Thai consonants for young children: listening, tracing, writing and matching games. It is a learning aid, not a replacement for a teacher, and it does not grade handwriting or pronunciation.

2. Accounts

  • A parent, guardian or other responsible adult must sign in with their own Google or LINE account. You must be an adult (or old enough to agree to these terms where you live).
  • You are responsible for activity on your account and for supervising children who use the Service with you.
  • Your use of Google or LINE is also governed by their own terms.

3. Acceptable use

Do not misuse the Service: no attempts to break into accounts or servers, overload or scrape the Service, get around usage limits, or use it to harm others. We may suspend access that puts the Service or other people at risk.

4. Teacher voice and learning content

The natural teacher voice is generated by AI and may occasionally mispronounce words. Original Thai recordings are offered as a fallback. Picture words name letters; the target letter does not always come first in the word. Please check with a Thai speaker or teacher if something seems wrong.

5. Content and credits

The app design, illustrations and text belong to OceanAds. Thai letter-name recordings and stroke models are based on NIU SEAsite (seasite.niu.edu). Fonts and other third-party materials remain the property of their owners. You may use the Service for personal and classroom learning; please do not copy or resell it.

6. Availability and changes

We aim to keep the Service running but may change, pause or stop features at any time. If we make important changes to these terms, we will update the date above and show a notice in the app. Continuing to use the Service means you accept the updated terms.

To the extent the law allows, OceanAds is not liable for indirect or consequential losses, or for lost data, arising from use of the free Service. Nothing in these terms limits rights you have under consumer protection laws that cannot be waived.

9. Ending use
